project.name: bot-pilot-google-calendar-connector-domain
project.description:
Google Calendar connector domain module.
Contains the GoogleCalendarCredentials JPA entity — the one piece of the domain that is inherently Google-specific (it persists OAuth2 tokens from Google's auth flow).
Why is this NOT in the calendar-spi? The credential schema (access_token, refresh_token, token_uri, scopes) is specific to Google OAuth2. Outlook would have a completely different credential structure. Keeping it here means the SPI stays provider-agnostic, and each connector owns its own persistence model.
This module may reference JPA annotations (jakarta.persistence) because the entity annotation is part of the domain model definition, not an infrastructure concern. Spring itself is NOT imported here.
